tuition_eu_eur: Anexo II masters (the in-scope AI/Data/Cybersecurity/Acoustics titles): 45,02 €/credit first enrolment × 60 ECTS = EUR 2,701.20 per full year — UPM prints this total itself. Máster en Formación del Profesorado: 16,92 €/credit × 60 = EUR 1,015.20. ⚠️ These EU rates apply to 'estudiantes de nacionalidad española, de cualquier estado miembro de la Unión Europea o nacionales de Marruecos y de Andorra' — Morocco and Andorra are named, TUNISIA IS NOT, so a Tunisian candidate does not get them.
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 5,044.20 for a full 60-ECTS Anexo II master — UPM publishes this total in a named non-resident-foreigner section. Mechanism and arithmetic: UPM applies to 'estudiantes extranjeros/as, mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los/las nacionales de estados miembros de la Unión Europea', for Anexo II masters, 'lo previsto para tercera y sucesivas matrículas' = 84,07 €/credit; 84,07 × 60 = 5.044,20 €. That is 45,02 → 84,07 €/credit, i.e. a 1.87× uplift. FOR THE TWO HABILITANTE TITLES THE UPLIFT IS FAR WORSE: non-residents pay the FOURTH-enrolment rate, 154,80 €/credit → EUR 9,288 for 60 ECTS (vs 1.165,80 € at EU rates — an 8.0× uplift). Formación del Profesorado: EUR 7,560. ⚠️ DECISIVE LEGAL POINT, quoted from UPM's own document: 'la autorización de estancia concedida a los/las estudiantes extranjeros/as de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes' — a Spanish study-stay authorisation does NOT make the candidate a resident, so enrolling and living in Madrid does not escape the surcharge. Legal basis: Decreto 43/2022 of the Comunidad de Madrid + art. 57.4 b) of Ley Orgánica 2/2023 del Sistema Universitario.

start_month: February (segundo cuatrimestre) — BUT CONDITIONAL, NOT A STANDING SECOND ENTRY. UPM's own calendar note reads verbatim: 'Existen dos periodos de preinscripción diferentes, el primero (que se abre en enero 2026) para toda la oferta formativa, y el segundo (a partir de octubre 2026) para aquellos programas que dispongan de plazas vacantes y su estructura académica les permita comenzar su impartición en el segundo cuatrimestre.' So the second period is a conditional overflow round, gated on TWO tests applied per programme: (a) the programme has vacant places, and (b) its academic structure permits a second-semester start. It is not published as a guaranteed February intake for any named title, and UPM does not publish a list of which programmes qualify. The first period is the one that covers the whole offer.
